pay_experience_credit_outofdistrict_014.evidence: All teachers shall receive full credit on the salary schedule for full-time outside school-teaching experience in pre-K to 12 accredited schools completed after the teacher received a Bachelor's degree.

pay_experience_credit_military_public_01.evidence: Credit shall be given for each year of military service or Teacher Corp service up to a maximum of four (4) years. A minimum of six (6) months' military service or Teacher Corp service is necessary to qualify for a year of service.

pay_national_board_017.evidence: If a teacher receives his/her National Board Certification, then the teacher will be paid an additional $1,000 per year as long as the teacher maintains that certification and remains a teacher in IPS.
